description: MZ-01 is the primary Regional Transport Office for Aizawl, the capital city of Mizoram. This office handles all major vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and permit services for the urban and central regions of Aizawl district. It is a critical hub for the Mizoram Transport Department, ensuring compliance with the Motor Vehicles Act across the state's capital.
address: District Transport Office, Edenthar, Aizawl, Mizoram

description: The MZ-02 RTO serves the Lunglei district, which is the second-largest district in Mizoram. It operates as the District Transport Office (DTO) responsible for vehicle registrations, issuing driving licenses, and enforcing transport regulations in the southern part of the state.
address: District Transport Office, Venglai, Lunglei, Mizoram

description: The MZ-03 RTO is the District Transport Office located in Siaha, serving the southernmost district of Mizoram. It is responsible for vehicle registration, driving licenses, and transport permits for the area governed by the Mara Autonomous District Council.
address: District Transport Office, Vengpui, Siaha, Mizoram

description: MZ-04 is the official code for the District Transport Office located in Champhai, Mizoram. This RTO is responsible for vehicle registration, issuance of driving licenses, and enforcement of the Motor Vehicles Act in the district near the Indo-Myanmar border.
address: District Transport Office, Karawt Veng, Champhai, Mizoram

description: The District Transport Office (DTO) in Kolasib is responsible for vehicle registration and the issuance of driving licenses within the Kolasib district. It serves as a key administrative body for transport regulations in northern Mizoram, facilitating movement along the crucial National Highway linking the state to the rest of India.
address: District Transport Office, Hmar Veng, Kolasib, Mizoram

description: The MZ-06 Regional Transport Office (RTO) is the District Transport Office located in Serchhip, Mizoram. It serves as the primary administrative body for vehicle registration, driving license issuance, and road safety enforcement for the Serchhip district.
address: District Transport Office, IOC Veng, New Serchhip, Serchhip, Mizoram

description: The MZ-07 RTO serves the Lawngtlai district in Mizoram, providing essential services such as vehicle registration and driving license issuance. It operates under the state's transport department to manage traffic regulations and road safety within the autonomous district council area.
address: District Transport Office (DTO) Lawngtlai, L-IV Lawngtlai, Mizoram - 796891

description: The MZ-08 Regional Transport Office serves the Mamit district in Mizoram, managing vehicle registrations and licensing services for the region. Located at the district headquarters, it plays a vital role in regulating transport activities and ensuring road safety across its jurisdiction near the Tripura border.
address: District Transport Office, Dinthar, Mamit, Mizoram

description: MZ-09 is the designated regional transport office for the Saitual district of Mizoram. Historically used for Aizawl Rural before being merged into MZ-01, the code was officially reassigned to the newly established Saitual district in September 2025 to manage local vehicle registration and licensing.

The MZ-10 RTO is the District Transport Office (DTO) for the Khawzawl district in Mizoram. It was established following the district's administrative creation to manage vehicle registrations, driving permits, and transport safety regulations for the local population. The MZ-10 code was officially assigned by the state government to streamline regional transport logistics.
address: District Transport Office, Khawzawl District, Mizoram
